## Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please provide a clear and concise description of what the problem is.
*E.g., I'm always frustrated when [...] / Our support agents struggle to [...]*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, design mockups, workflow diagrams, or screenshots about the feature request here.
